howto: Pick a level and press Start Adventure.
Solve the sum and tap the right answer (or press 1 to 4) to attack the monster.
A wrong answer lets the monster hit you, and it also attacks every few seconds. Defeat monsters for gold and XP; a boss comes every 5 kills.
tips: Three right answers in a row build a x3 combo for triple damage.
Spend gold in the Shop: a sword hits harder, a shield adds health, a potion heals fully.
Answering within about a second builds a Quick streak.
When you are defeated you can revive for 25 gold and keep your level.

controls.keyboard: 1 to 4 answer. Enter starts or revives. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap an answer; tap Shop, Hunting Log and War Medals for more

difficulty: Five level bands with an age guide: Easy (ages 5-6), Medium (7-8), Hard (9-10, times tables to 12), Insane (11-12) and Max (13+). Harder bands unlock as your hero levels up, and monsters get tougher with every kill.

features.age-or-level-bands: Level buttons on the title, each with an age guide
features.hints: The right answer lights up after every answer; the arcade Hint gives a strategy for the current sum
features.grown-up-progress-report: Grown-ups button on the title: answers and accuracy per level, practice days, the sums missed most and a suggested next level
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first battle (the monster waits); replay with Learn to play
features.results: Defeated card with kills, level, gold and best, plus Revive and New Run
